{{Top|leg}}
'''Fiber-chain''' was a form of rope, developed from linked rings of durable fiber, which gave it the appearance of a chain.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|270|fiber-chain}}</ref>

The ''[[go-zeki]]'' [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] of the [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] [[Species/Legends|species]] wielded [[fiber-chained razorhat]]s, relying on the fiber-chain to return the thrown [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] to their grasp.<ref name="Wolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref>
